name: Idol to 〇〇 Shicha Dame Desu ka?
original_name: アイドルと〇〇しちゃダメですか？
source:
You've become the manager of new idol group Melonchu. 

In order to make their first live performance a success, romance with idols is a no-no!
But love flags keep rising one after another, and the members' affinity levels are at maximum right from the start.

How will they get through this predicament!?

A first in the otome game world (?!) a slapstick romantic comedy where romance is forbidden!
translation:
你已经成为新偶像团体Melonchu的经纪人。

为了让他们的第一次现场演出取得成功，与偶像谈恋爱是绝对不行的！
但爱情的旗帜却不断升起，成员们的好感度从一开始就达到了最高。

他们将如何度过这个困境！？

乙女游戏界首创（？！）禁止浪漫的闹剧浪漫喜剧！
